title: CDSCO Approves AstraZeneca's Enhertu for Neoadjuvant HER2-Positive Breast Cancer
summary: New Delhi: AstraZeneca Pharma India Limited has received permission from the Central Drugs Standard Control Organisation (CDSCO), Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS), Government of India, to...
thbAction: Position THB's pharma CRM and omnichannel HCP engagement workflows to support launch planning, KAM orchestration, and compliant follow-up across India and the Middle East.
contentHtml:
New Delhi: AstraZeneca Pharma India Limited has received permission from the Central Drugs Standard Control Organisation (CDSCO), Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS), Government of India, to import, market and distribute Trastuzumab Deruxtecan 100 mg/5 mL lyophilized powder for concentrate for solution for infusion (Enhertu) for an additional indication in India.

M. Pharm (Pharmaceutics)
